title: helianthemum oelandicum subsp. marifolium
intro: Helianthemum oelandicum subsp. marifolium, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cistaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of wounds and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes. The bioactive constituents of Rock Rose also exhibit immunomodulatory and antiseptic properties, contributing to its potential therapeutic applications.
